output.question: What are Alphabet's latest earnings results?
output.answer: Alphabet's latest results cover Q3 2026, the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and were released on October 28, 2026. Revenue rose 25% year over year to $127.6 billion. Google Cloud revenue more than doubled (+103%) to $30.7 billion, and Google Services brought in $96.3 billion (+11%). Operating income rose 30% to $40.6 billion. Diluted EPS fell to $2.12 from $2.87 a year earlier, mainly because other income/expense swung to an $8.2 billion net expense, driven by an $8.7 billion loss on equity securities. CNBC reported that revenue and adjusted EPS ($2.67 vs. $3.02 expected) missed estimates and that the shares fell more than 10%. Alphabet kept its 2026 capex guidance at $195–205 billion and said capex will 'increase significantly' in 2027.

key_facts.fact: Q3 2026 (quarter ended Sept 30, 2026) consolidated revenue was $127.6B ($127,577M), up 25% YoY
Google Cloud revenue rose 103% to $30.7B; Google Services revenue was $96.3B, up 11%
Operating income was $40.6B ($40,576M), up 30%, with an operating margin of about 31.8%
Net income was $26.5B ($26.2B available to common stockholders); diluted EPS was $2.12 vs $2.87 in Q3 2025
Other income (expense), net was an $8.2B expense vs $12.8B income a year earlier, driven by an $8.7B loss on equity securities
Q3 capex (purchases of property and equipment) was $51.4B
Adjusted EPS of $2.67 vs $3.02 expected (LSEG); revenue of $127.58B vs $128.22B expected; shares fell more than 10%
2026 capex guidance was held at $195–205B; the CFO expects capex to increase significantly in 2027
Search revenue rose 12% to $63.35B vs a $64.96B estimate; free cash flow was negative $9.07B

passages.quote: Consolidated Alphabet revenues increased 25% to $127.6 billion
Google Cloud delivered record growth as revenues increased 103% to $30.7 billion
We had a strong quarter and are now on a half-trillion dollar revenue run rate.
Alphabet sinks 10% as it holds 2026 capex unchanged, expects significant increase in 2027
We continue to expect our capex to increase significantly in 2027, and will provide further details on our Q4 call.

caveats: The adjusted EPS ($2.67) and the consensus estimates come from CNBC/LSEG and FactSet, not from Alphabet, which reports GAAP diluted EPS of $2.12. MarketBeat gives the consensus as $3.01 in one report and $3.02 in another.

A search summary said the equity-securities loss was due mainly to Alphabet's SpaceX investment. The fetched summary of the press release says SpaceX is not mentioned, so this is unverified and left out of the answer.
CNBC's description of the 2026 capex guidance ('held at $195–205B, up from $190B in Q2') is internally unclear. The range is reported as unchanged from the prior quarter's guidance.
Shares fell more than 10% in the reaction to the report. The price may have moved a lot since October 28, 2026.
The next report (Q4 2026) is expected around late January or early February 2027, so these are the latest results as of 2026-11-11.
